offers_products.reason: Builds and sells single-family homes, townhomes and condominiums through seven subsidiary homebuilder brands.

offers_services.reason: Homes are the main offering; mortgage and title services through affiliates are secondary add-ons for homebuyers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Homebuyers and families purchase its homes in Dallas, Austin, Houston, Atlanta and Treasure Coast.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells homes to individual homebuyers; no business or government buyers are described.

recurring_revenue.reason: Each home is a one-time purchase by a buyer; revenue comes from home closings.

cyclical_demand.reason: New home purchases are easily postponed in downturns and are sensitive to the economy and mortgage rates.

big_ticket.reason: A home is the largest, rarest purchase for a household.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for built homes, a physical product, rather than staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are individual households buying homes.

asset_heavy.reason: Homebuilder needs land and lot inventory, but not plants, fleets or networks; it is mainly working-capital based.

notes: Asset-heavy is borderline because land and lot inventory requires heavy capital.
